name: Mahou Seijo Himekishi Kanon ~Kukkorose! Shokushu Mamire no Kyonyuu Henshin Bishoujo Senshi~
original_name: 魔法聖女 姫騎士カノン ～くっ殺せ！ 触手まみれの巨乳変身美少女戦士～
source:
A certain prestigious academy... At late night, in the school building, one beautiful Holy Knight was fighting against a group of tentacles.
She was Izumi Kanon.
During daytime, Kanon was a normal high school girl. But during night, she changed into the figure of a beautiful knight who protected the academy. 
She spent her days fighting against demons and beasts to keep them away from the academy.

One day, a beautiful girl transferred in Kanon's class.
The name of the transfer student was Kagura Shouko.
Unexpectedly due to chance, the two became close friends. However Shouko was attacked by a monster at the academy during night...Due to her close friend taken as a hostage, Kanon fell into a predicament.
However, at that time Shouko awakened to the power of Holy Knight and changed into the figure of a beautiful warrior!

In the end, what is the conclusion of the life and death struggle of the two female warriors---!?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=967176]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
某知名学院…… 深夜，校舍内，一名美丽的圣骑士正在与一群触手战斗。
她就是泉加音。
白天，加音是一名普通的女高中生。但到了晚上，她就变成了守护学园的美丽骑士。
她每天都在与恶魔和野兽战斗，让它们远离学院。

有一天，加隆的班级里转来了一位美丽的女孩。
转校生的名字叫神乐翔子。
没想到因机缘巧合，两人成了亲密的朋友。然而，翔子却在夜间在学园遭到了怪物的袭击……由于好友被劫为人质，加隆陷入了困境。
然而，此时翔子觉醒了圣骑士的力量，变成了美丽的战士形象！

两位女战士的生死搏斗最终的结局是什么——！？

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=967176]Getchu[/url]]
